entries.1dc4a6c38519c181: This business holds and manages digital assets (crypto assets) centered on Ethereum (ETH), and promotes treasury (financial and fund management) strategies that utilize the company's balance sheet. In addition to acquiring digital assets using raised funds and operating secure custody and management systems, it generates income by staking and by operating held assets in decentralized finance (DeFi) and similar activities. This new business, launched in September 2025, recorded revenue from external customers of ¥37 million in the fiscal year ended March 2026.
entries.381d0095f9aa61ef: This is hands-on consulting service covering overall management issues, from the offensive area such as formulating business strategy to the defensive area such as establishing internal controls.
entries.4b4150fafc4d1a59: This business provides hands-on management consulting services covering overall management issues, from the offensive area such as formulating business strategy to the defensive area such as establishing internal controls, for mid-sized and small enterprises nationwide and for large domestic companies. In its core IT Engineering area, it provides IT solutions comprehensively, including resident technical support (SES and staff dispatch) that directly supports DX promotion and system development at clients' sites. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥816 million.
